name: 代替テキストと触覚を分類したアクセシビリティ設定
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0092. ORIGINAL sources are authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Input roles: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: edit-target-generated-candidate. Preserve locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Edit the latest candidate ONLY as follows. Keep its exact360x180 logical panel and positions, five Japanese strings, two source icons, divider, all three outlined white OFF switches with gray LEFT thumbs. Enlarge ONLY the THREE REGULAR option-label texts by25 percent so they read at14px/24px logical scale. Enlarge ONLY the TWO BOLD heading texts by15 percent so they also read at14px/24px logical scale. All five text blocks must have equal14px nominal glyph scale, differing only in bold/regular weight. Do not make the option labels bold. All labels remain single lines, text anchors fixed; enough room exists before switches. Reduce both leading icon shapes10 percent around their centers for18px appearance. No layout change, no extra whitespace, no color/state change, no source icon replacement, no generic filled switch tracks. Preserve every Japanese character and punctuation. The output bitmap inspection resolution is not CSS scale.
reviewNotes: Compact360x180 versus390x280 mock; exact5 texts, Regular body enlarged toward14/24 and two Bold headings retained. Source circled-person/vibrating-phone icons, three outlined white OFF gray LEFT thumbs and divider restored. Approximate headings15 versus14, icons17/18 and switch34x20 versus32x18 residuals; bitmap font identity, native behavior and owner acceptance unverified.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
